verdict.line: You lose extended trades whenever Kled chains Violent Tendencies into a Jousting-Bear Trap combo before level 6, but you win the matchup by refusing those fights, farming safely, and out-scaling him into a split-push once the Maiden comes online.

brief.thesis: This lane is even in raw trading power but Kled owns the solo-kill windows through his burst combos, which is why OP.GG calls the shape defensive even though Yorick wins the head-to-head 55.3% of the time over 47 games. Your structural edge isn't lane dominance, it's that Dark Procession and Mourning Mist let you decline bad fights entirely, bank graves, and let the Maiden take over the game once your core items land.

theirWindow.what: He gets four attack-speed-boosted hits with a harder fourth one, and this is usually when he commits Jousting (E) into Bear Trap (Q) for an all-in. Disengage behind minions or your wall rather than trading face-to-face.

yourWindow.when: When his W is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: His per-hit damage drops sharply without the attack speed buff, so this is when you engage: land Mourning Mist (E) for the armor shred and slow, then empower an auto with Last Rites (Q) to maximize the trade.

start.why: The flat damage reduction on autos directly dulls Jousting (E) poke and Bear Trap (Q) pull damage, and it's the higher-winrate, higher-pick-rate start (50% over 34 games) for exactly this kind of auto-attack-heavy lane.

boots.why: Kled's damage is almost entirely physical and auto-reliant, especially during his Violent Tendencies (W) windows, so flat armor from Steelcaps blunts that far better than magic resist boots do.

core.why: Gives you the attack speed, damage, and movement spike needed to actually win extended trades and to stick onto him once you commit to a fight.
Ability haste lowers your Last Rites (Q) cooldown further, letting you dig graves faster and sustain through more wave contact per Grasp proc.
Armor penetration plus the slow pairs with Mourning Mist (E) to stop him from Jousting away once he's marked and committed.

situational.when: he leans on sustained auto-attack trading to out-duel your empowered Q hits
you need more shred to punish Skaarl's high base armor in extended fights
the lane goes even and you want to prioritize split-push sieging over dueling

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp heals you off wave contact every few seconds, matching the defensive, farm-first shape this matchup actually has. Master-tier Yorick players (969 games) instead run Conqueror from Precision for more sustained all-in pressure during his dismounted window — worth trying once you're comfortable taking fights rather than farming past them.

summoners.why: Teleport is the highest pick-rate choice (56.1%) and lets you execute the farm-and-reset plan: pull waves to a safe spot before level 6, then teleport back in to join a siege once the Maiden is live. Ignite (47.6% WR, 36.8% pick) is the alternative if you'd rather convert the solo-kill-even windows into kills instead of scaling.

playing.title: Pull waves before level 6
playing.detail: Farm from a position where you can reset to tower rather than standing to trade into his Jousting (E) and Bear Trap (Q) package, which is strongest in these early levels.

playing.title: Track his W, not just his health
playing.detail: Violent Tendencies (CD 13/12/11/10/9s) is the real damage spike — four empowered autos with a harder fourth hit. Avoid committing to fights while it's up.

playing.title: Don't trust your wall past level 3
playing.detail: Once he's chaining E into Q, his second Jousting dash (the return cast) can pass through terrain, so Dark Procession's wall will not block that return hit — don't position as if it will.

playing.title: Feed Last Rites to minions when he's safe
playing.detail: If you can't land the empowered auto on Kled, use it on casters instead to keep your sustain and grave count climbing.

playing.title: Respect the dismount window differently
playing.detail: A dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and his Q swaps to the self-knockback Pocket Pistol — this is a good moment to disengage rather than chase, since he remounts with a health chunk once Skaarl's courage maxes.

playing.title: Start split pushing at 11+
playing.detail: Once Trinity Force and Spear of Shojin are online, push side waves with the Maiden (R) up so he has to choose between a losing 1v1 or losing tempo.

playing.title: Use Mourning Mist to seal trades
playing.detail: The armor shred and slow (CD 12/11/10/9/8s) is what makes sure your empowered Last Rites auto actually connects before he can Joust away.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured Yorick vs Kled games on the current patch (16.20.1); the timings, wall interaction, and trade-window reasoning are the author's own read of the kit, not part of the OP.GG sample.

stats.opponentTip: Try to fight him when (W) is on cooldown. Try to pull lane to farm before reaching level 6. If Kled uses (E)-(Q) when he reaches level 3, his second (E) can go through walls so avoid being hit.
